277880260.description:
You are purchasing a "Set of 3 Hemingray Blue-Green Glass Insulators" in "Used" condition.
Set of three classic Hemingray glass insulators, perfect for collectors, rustic decor, or upcycling projects. These iconic blue-green insulators have great character, with visible bubbles and swirls in the glass that give each piece a unique look. All three feature embossed Hemingray/H.G. Co. markings and patent information, making them ideal display pieces on a shelf, in a window, or as part of a vintage industrial-inspired decor setup. The drip-point bases and old glass texture add to their antique charm. Whether you collect telegraph and power line history or just love vintage glass, this trio will make a standout addition to your collection. Keywords: Hemingray insulator, glass insulators, vintage insulators, antique glass, telegraph insulator, blue green glass, drip point insulator, rustic farmhouse decor, industrial decor, collectible glass
Condition Notes:
Set of three blue-green Hemingray glass insulators with visible surface wear, including scuffs, scratches, bubbles, and manufacturing swirls in the glass. Some discoloration and dirt deposits are present, especially near the bases and within the threads. Embossed lettering remains legible on each piece. Base drip points are intact with minor chipping and roughness in areas consistent with age and use.

Description
: Explore Earth's ancient past with this 12-piece Fossil Collection Kit, perfect for science enthusiasts and collectors alike. Each fossil is individually bagged and accompanied by an educational card describing its origin and significance, including gastropods, pelycopods, horn coral, crinoid stems, brachiopods, trilobites, dinosaur bone, ammonites, fossil wood, algae, and shark teeth. The set includes a colorful timeline card mapping major periods of prehistoric life, making it a valuable educational tool. Ideal for students, teachers, or hobbyists, these fossils offer hands-on learning about natural history and paleontology. All items shown are included, and each fossil appears in its own clear, labeled packet for easy viewing and storage. The set is presented in good visible condition, with all key contents intact and readable. Delight in the tactile experience of real fossils and enrich your educational collection or science display with this fascinating assortment.
This is a pre-owned item donated to Goodwill of Northern Michigan.
